name: gallery-hero
title: Gallery hero
description: A full-bleed photograph opening a series: the picture, caption and credit, a counter with Previous and Next, and thumbnails that switch it.
docs: photos is an array of { src, alt, title, place?, year?, credit? } and initial the index shown first; give each photo srcSet and sizes for responsive files and thumb for a small file in the strip, so a series of large pictures does not load them all as thumbnails. The caption bar writes the title and place on the left, the year and credit on the right, and a "03 / 08" counter beside Previous and Next. A strip of thumbnails switches the picture, and so do the arrow keys, Home and End while focus is inside the gallery, and a swipe on a touch screen. A new picture fades in over the old one, the pictures either side are fetched ahead, the caption is announced through a polite live region, and no timer ever advances it. title stays small in a corner so the photograph carries the page; cta adds a link in the other corner. onIndexChange(index) tells your page which picture is showing; it is a function, so use the hero inside a Client Component then. Pass labels to translate the fixed words.
